note: Both sets are heavily duplicated and contain garbled entities ('axis telescope', 'n-axis telescope', 'spacecraft', 'baseline mission concept') that misbind instrument counts, and both wrongly treat Lynx's 10 m as a mirror-assembly 'size/dimension' rather than focal length. Set A additionally captures the correct Lynx focal length of 10 m and the starshade 'flying in formation' condition, which Set B never states correctly. Set B's coverage is otherwise similar but it omits the focal length fact entirely and adds an invented condition ('spacecraft with starshade') on a vague claim. Overall A is slightly more complete and faithful despite one extra low-quality claim.
